service_rules.name: Inspect tire
service_rules.notes: Yearly also for sidewall cracks from age; no bicycle-tire age limit was found.

service_rules.name: Top up sealant
service_rules.notes: Stan's: sealant lasts 2–6 months; check every 3 months (stans.com sealant support).

service_rules.name: Clean out and renew sealant
service_rules.notes: Stan's: take the tire off and clean out old sealant once a year; check rim tape and valves at the same time (stans.com sealant support).

service_rules.name: Replace valve core
service_rules.notes: At the yearly sealant clean-out; personal value.

service_rules.name: Check and grease thru-axle
service_rules.notes: Personal value.

service_rules.name: Check and grease thru-axle
service_rules.notes: Personal value.

service_rules.name: Charge Di2 battery
service_rules.notes: Shimano BT-DN300: about 1000 km per charge (less with much front shifting); 800 km leaves a margin. Source: retailer listings (Rose, Tweeks), not verified with Shimano.

service_rules.name: Charge power meter
service_rules.notes: Set to your power meter's battery life with a margin.

service_rules.name: Charge power-meter pedals
service_rules.notes: Favero Assioma PRO RS-1: at least 60 h per charge (up to about 160 h after a firmware update). 80 h is your choice (2026-10-26). Source: retailer listings quoting Favero, not verified.

service_rules.name: Replace sensor battery
service_rules.notes: Magene S3+ (CR2032): about 500 h of riding per battery (retailer listings, not verified with Magene); 400 h leaves a margin. 12 months covers standby drain (your estimate).

service_rules.name: Replace shifter coin cells
service_rules.notes: Wireless Di2 levers (CR1632): about 1.5–2 years (retailer listings); 18 months leaves a margin. Off by default (wired and mechanical levers have no coin cell); switch it on for wireless levers. Keep CR1632 cells as counted stock to pick them when logging.

service_rules.name: Charge bike computer
service_rules.notes: Set to your device's battery life with a margin (personal value).

service_rules.name: Charge light
service_rules.notes: Set to your light's run time in the mode you use (personal value).

service_rules.name: Charge radar
service_rules.notes: Set to your radar's run time in the mode you use (personal value).

service_rules.name: Check pulley wheels
service_rules.notes: Common workshop practice, not a maker's figure.

service_rules.name: Check chainring wear
service_rules.notes: Check at least at every chain change; common practice, not a maker's figure.

service_rules.name: Replace quick link
service_rules.notes: Wippermann Connex links are sold as reusable many times; no official limit was found. Replace after 2 chains (your choice) or as soon as it closes noticeably looser than new.

service_rules.name: Check rim tape
service_rules.notes: Check at every tire change or yearly (tubes: tape covers the spoke holes; tubeless: it seals).

service_rules.name: Inspect brake hoses and caliper
service_rules.notes: With every fluid change or yearly; personal value.

service_rules.name: Bed in new pads
service_rules.notes: Once after fitting; after 100 km without it the pads count as bedded in.

service_rules.name: Bed in new rotor
service_rules.notes: Once after fitting; after 100 km without it the rotor counts as bedded in.

service_rules.name: Service pedal bearings
service_rules.notes: Rider figure, not a maker's interval.

service_rules.name: Service pedal bearings
service_rules.notes: No Favero interval found; riders regrease Assioma pedals about yearly or every 2,500 km.

service_rules.name: Check bottom bracket
service_rules.notes: Personal value.

service_rules.name: Inspect bar tape
service_rules.notes: Personal value.

service_rules.name: Re-paste seatpost
service_rules.notes: Stops a seatpost from seizing; personal value.

service_rules.name: Check derailleur hanger
service_rules.notes: Also after every crash; personal value.

service_rules.name: Inspect cleats
service_rules.notes: Replace when a wear pad is worn through or clipping feels different, often about 6,000 km (rider figure; BikeRadar).

service_rules.name: Check shift cable
service_rules.notes: Personal value.

service_rules.name: Check shift housing
service_rules.notes: Personal value.

service_rules.name: Torque check
service_rules.notes: Every 3 months and once after the first ride on a newly fitted part (personal value). Torque values come from each product's spec (torque_nm) where you entered it.

service_rules.name: Di2 check (firmware, errors)
service_rules.notes: Firmware is updated with Shimano E-TUBE; 6 months is a personal value.

service_rules.name: Inspect Di2 wires
service_rules.notes: Personal value.

service_rules.name: Yearly full service
service_rules.notes: Once a year, a full service of the whole bike: Wheel hub bearings: play and roughness; Headset: clean, grease, check play; Bottom bracket: play and noise; Brakes: bleed (or check lever feel), hoses, pads, rotors; Di2 wires and junction / shift cables and housing; Frame and fork: cracks, dents, chips; Drivetrain: deep clean, chain, cassette and chainring wear; Pedals: bearing play; Torque check of all bolts. Personal value; each job keeps its own reminder.
